from pathlib import Path
import textwrap
program = '''def transform(grid):
    # The first row gives a repeating color sequence. The lower-left triangle
    # uses that sequence shifted forward by one position; zeros hide cells.
    first = grid[0]
    n = len(first)
    period = next(
        p for p in range(1, n + 1)
        if all(value == 0 or value == first[c % p] for c, value in enumerate(first))
    )
    base = first[:period]
    return [[base[(c + (1 if c < r else 0)) % period]
             for c in range(n)] for r in range(len(grid))]
'''
